limitations: Generated torso underlay is local placeholder art, not approved new design.
Arm art can expose gaps under rotation; reach mismatch is measured, not hidden.
Support projection is an authored 2D trial, not a verified 3D anatomical solution.
Torso lean warps existing upper-body pixels, with the head following the torso. No raised-shoulder replacement art or independent head correction yet.
Whole-torso lean is now off by default. Local shoulder trial keeps the head and body axis fixed; its socket outlines remain provisional, especially near -55 aim.
Raised-body pivot is an independent weapon-path trial. It releases the old rear-stock anchor but can increase trigger-arm reach error; it is not an approved arm solution.
Aim-follow was removed from the interactive comparison after the user clarified the desired fixed-center swept band. Its math remains only as a regression reference.

The fixed virtual pivot now starts at rise 192, adjustable to 640 source pixels. Stock and muzzle paths show the swept band, not a firing-range increase. Arm sockets and reach are not repaired by this change.

Arm-connection V2 is now the sandbox default: refined visible cuts, fixed shoulder sockets, source-pixel joint overlaps and bounded 0.75-1.4 length-axis projection. At rise 192 the canonical down sector reaches both unchanged grips, but anatomical naturalness and large projection remain review items. Extreme settings can still exceed reach; the old arm/shoulder trial remains selectable.
Support reach is checked for the default mirrored ground sector; air, legacy, non-mirrored and trigger-arm issues remain.
Only down-aim sector +/-35 degrees is tested; no full Unity gameplay replacement.

trajectory.groundExtensionNote: New fixed-pivot extension beyond existing -55 clamp, not an existing Unity ground pose.
trajectory.mapping: Right-facing serialized aim geometry, normalized to existing front rifle length; not validated world-scale matching.
